==========================================================
These First Appeals filed under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, are
against the judgment and award dated 30.01.2018 passed in M.A.C.P. No. 1003 of
2017, M.A.C.P. No. 1002 of 2017, M.A.C.P. No. 1004 of 2017, M.A.C.P. No. 1005 of
2017, M.A.C.P. No. 1006 of 2017 and M.A.C.P. No. 1001 of 2017 on the file of Motor
Accident Claims Tribunal (Aux), Halol partially allowing the claim petitions or
compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
Icici Lombard General Insurance vs Mohanbhai Saburbhai Baria on 8 March, 2025

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88943634/

These appeals coming on for conciliation before Lok Adalat, the following order is passed :
Common Conciliation Order
1.

Learned advocate for the appellant has tendered withdrawal pursis dated
08.03.2025, which are taken on record.

He seeks permission to withdraw all appeals
as per the pursis.
2. Permission, as pray
ed for, is granted.
In view of the pursis submitted by learned advocate for the appellant, these appeals NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/4428/2019 CONCILIATION ORDER DATED: 08/03/2025 undefined stand disposed of as withdrawn.
No order as to costs.

3. Since the appeals are withdrawn, the claimed amount lying with the bank in the form of FDs/ lying either with the Tribunal or with the Nazir Branch of this Court may be disbursed in favour of the claimants after due verification by way of RTGS/NEFT.
4. Necessary Court fees, if any, be refunded to the appellant, as per the provisions of Section 21(1) of the Legal Services Authority Act, 1987.
5. The order passed in these appeals shall not be treated as precedent.
6. Registry is directed to transmit the record and proceedings to the Tribunal forthwith and place a copy of the order in each of the connected matters.
(S. V. PINTO,J) CONCILIATOR (TEJAS M. BAROT, DESIGNATED SENIOR ADVOCATE)
